statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is elevated on the last verified Nasdaq futures gap, high oil, near-5% Treasury yields and weak Asian equities; fresh granular NQ retracement evidence is unavailable.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: orange. Classification depends on whether European price discovery shows meaningful gap repair and two-way rotations or renewed directional extension.
headline: Elevated Tail persists into Europe handoff as oil and rates stay stressed
body: Reuters last verified Nasdaq futures down 1.1% versus S&P futures down 0.4%, Brent near $107.36 and the U.S. 10-year near 4.974%. Asian equities were weaker. These are aligned amplifiers, but sufficiently fresh granular NQ retracement evidence was unavailable at the cutoff.

lookbackSummary: Tail was 19% through 21:00 UTC on September 13, rose to 24% at the Globex reopening hour, then entered the elevated band as the Nasdaq futures gap and cross-asset stress persisted into Asia.
outlookSummary: Tail stays elevated into the Europe handoff while the overnight gap and energy/rates stress remain unresolved. It de-escalates conditionally with meaningful gap repair and two-way trade, then rises again around the U.S. cash open if one-way structure reappears.
